artifact_type: selected public provider metadata and source-qualification decision

screen.screen_result: One candidate reports 5 m coordinate uncertainty; two report roughly 30 km or 49 km uncertainty; two have unspecified uncertainty and potentially related specimen/sample lineage; one has no coordinates and only a year. This is the specified GBIF query, not all UAE evidence.

photo.creator: James Hardcastle
photo.visual_review_method: Original provider JPEG loaded once in a read-only browser tab; rendered photograph inspected. No image processing or botanical expert verification.
photo.visible_content: Ground/oblique view of trees, foliage, trunks/roots and shallow standing water; no surveyed scale, mapped footprint, full-cell cover fraction or spatially referenced absence evidence.

decision.accepted_use: Dated third-party species-presence and alternative UAE site lead; provider-reported identification and position, not a team field measurement.
limitations: Research grade is a provider status, not guaranteed taxonomic or positional correctness.
No confirmed camera-to-organism offset, observation footprint, full-cell canopy fraction or complete absence survey.
May field presence does not directly validate the November frozen map at another site.
Presence-only opportunistic sampling cannot estimate overall map accuracy, false positives or ecological change.

Visual inspection does not provide botanical expert verification, a surveyed organism position or a whole-cell cover label. The two identifications (one improving and one supporting) are not two independent field replicates.
No causal intervention, baseline/follow-up outcome or aircraft measurement is supplied.
decision.next_gate: Photographic content is now checked, but organism position/footprint, a matched-date EO test and an evaluable sampling design remain unqualified. Do not acquire new EO assets or compute an accuracy score merely to turn this opportunistic presence record into a pixel label. A separately justified point-specific study must retain these limits and preserve the frozen Kalba core.

definition_sources.root_verified_scope: iNaturalist describes an organism encounter and an observer-location/accuracy-circle entry workflow. Research grade reflects community identification and data-quality status; it does not measure EO registration or certify complete-cell cover.
